papers.title_en: Quantum Logic Codes: Complete Transversal Logical Clifford Instruction Sets for High-Rate Stabilizer Quantum Error Correcting Codes
papers.evidence: 表面码和环面码的横向门，稳定子纠错进展
papers.tldr: 稳定子量子纠错码的横向逻辑门是实现容错量子计算的关键。本文识别了生成完整Clifford代数的电路深度下界，并构建了深度一横向S门和块内CZ门等新型操作。同时设计了高码率非LDPC CSS码族，具有常数深度的完整2-局部横向逻辑Clifford基指令集，包含所有靶向S、sqrt(X)和CZ门。该码族通过小码拼接扩展，保持深度一结构，称为量子逻辑码，为实用化容错量子计算提供了高效架构。
papers.abstract_en: We study the structure and transversal logical capabilities of stabilizer quantum error correcting codes. Among our results, we identify universal lower bounds on circuit depth to generate a full logical Clifford algebra, and develop novel constructions of logical transversal gates including a new depth-one transversal phase $\mathrm{\overline{S}}$ gate in the rotated surface code and a depth-one intra-block $\mathrm{\overline{CZ}}$ gate in the 2D-toric code that generalizes to all odd distances and all lengths $L\ge3$, respectively. Finally, we construct a high-rate non-LDPC CSS code family with parameters $[[n,\sqrt{n},Θ({n^β})]]$ where $β\approx 0.2823$ in one demonstrated case, that provably possesses a constant-depth complete 2-local transversal logical Clifford basis instruction set architecture (ISA) composed of all individually targeted $\mathrm{\overline{S}}$, $\mathrm{\overline{SHS}} = \sqrt{X}$, and $\mathrm{\overline{CZ}}$ gates. This ISA is depth-one for certain subfamilies that we design and generally constant-depth under certain conditions. The code family is built from a small code with parameters $[[n_0, 2, d_0]]$, and is tunable in the standard way: it tiles out to form utility-scale logical qubit counts, and it scales up through concatenation to achieve higher distances and error suppression. We show that this construction preserves the depth-one complete transversal logical Clifford basis ISA when composed with these commuting construction actions, inheriting structure from the core codes so that at scale the complete logical Clifford basis ISA remains depth-one up to depth-two addressable operations between tiled cores. We call these Quantum Logic Codes.

papers.title_en: All about quantum error correction: distillation, mitigation, self-correction and beyond
papers.evidence: 统一量子纠错技术的综述，涵盖蒸馏、缓解、自纠正等
papers.tldr: 量子信息处理面临多种错误，现有蒸馏、错误缓解等技术看似独立。本文通过将量子纠错扩展到状态自适应、信道自适应和多阶段编码，构建了统一框架，证明这些技术均为其特例。基于该框架，提出了自纠正量子存储器模型。这一统一视角不仅厘清了技术间关系，也为设计可靠量子信息系统提供了指导。
papers.abstract_en: In this work, it is shown that many quantum error-manipulating techniques, such as distillation, error mitigation, and dynamical decoupling, are special cases of the most general framework for quantum error correction. This unifying perspective is achieved by extending quantum error correction to include state-adaptive and channel-adaptive settings, as well as multi-stage coding scenarios. Based on this insight, a model of self-correcting quantum memory is also proposed. This work clarifies the relationship among these techniques and illustrates, through explicit constructions, how the unified perspective can guide the design of reliable quantum information systems.

papers.evidence: 涵盖量子纠错码，包括表面码和qLDPC码
papers.tldr: 纠错在条码扫描、可靠通信和量子计算等领域至关重要。本文呈现《纠错码手册》，它是“纠错动物园”的简化参考，系统分类经典与量子纠错码的描述，并记录码间关系及与球堆积、格、设计、群、物质相等相关对象的联系。手册旨在作为严格参考和实用工具，帮助研究人员追踪纠错码的关系网络并发现新连接。
papers.abstract_en: Barcode scans, clear phone calls, reliable data storage, satellite communication, and large-scale quantum computation are all made possible by error correction. We present a handbook version of The Error Correction Zoo, a curated reference of methods for protecting classical or quantum information from errors during storage and transmission. The handbook includes descriptions of these error-correcting codes and a classification according to the symbols they use. It also catalogues relations among codes and related objects such as sphere packings, lattices, designs, groups, and classical and quantum phases of matter. The collection is intended both as a rigorous reference and as a practical aid for tracing the web of code relationships and uncovering new connections.

papers.title_en: Quasilinear Equivalence Checking for Detector Error Models
papers.evidence: 用于容错量子电路的探测器误差模型
papers.tldr: 量子电路中的Detector Error Model (DEM)是一种结构化错误机制表示，用于捕捉容错性。本文为DEM建立了等式理论和范畴语义，提出了一个基于对称幺半理论（PROP）和Giry单子的重写系统，该系统可终止、合流，且每个DEM项有唯一范式。范式的计算复杂度为拟线性时间O(k|E|log|E|)，其中|E|为指令数，k为目标集大小。该系统通过Tanner图提供了结构等价性的完整不变量，首次实现了非自适应量子纠错管线的完全精确等价判定，并能扩展到部分自适应电路（如晶格手术、分布式量子纠错）而不产生指数开销。该工作为量子编译器的验证和优化提供了理论基础和高效算法。
papers.abstract_en: A Detector Error Model (DEM) is a structured representation of error mechanisms in quantum circuits, which has gained popularity in quantum compilation pipelines for its ability to capture fault-tolerance at a circuit level. It lists error mechanisms as instructions targeting detectors and observables, specifying for each physical fault channel the probability that the fault fires, the detectors it triggers, and the observables it flips.   In this paper, we develop an equational theory for DEMs, with its associated categorical semantics. We present a sound, terminating, confluent rewriting system for DEM terms, formulating it as a symmetric monoidal theory (a PROP) over the Giry monad. We prove that every DEM term has a unique normal form, which can be computed efficiently in quasilinear time $O(k|E|\log|E|)$, where $|E|$ is the number of instructions and $k$ bounds the size of a target set. This provides a complete set of invariants (via Tanner graphs) for structural DEM equivalence. We provide the first static decision procedure for DEM equivalence, with rigorous correctness guarantees. It is complete (decides full decoder-equivalence exactly) for non-adaptive quantum error correction (QEC) pipelines, and scales to a sound and applicable decision procedure for partially-adaptive circuits (lattice surgery, distributed QEC, ...) without suffering exponential overhead. We discuss its application to the verification and optimisation of quantum compilers.
